desc: Implement the parity check: if R is odd, print "No".
For even R, construct a cycle of R Reds using a $2 \times (R/2)$ grid pattern.

Distribute B Blues into the edges of the Red cycle. If $B \le R$, assign one Blue to each of the first B edges. If $B > R$, assign one Blue to each edge and put the rest in the first edge using a vertical chain.
For each Blue insertion, calculate coordinates that are orthogonal to the start Red and diagonal to the end Red, ensuring no collisions by using unique rows/columns.
Print "Yes" and the sequence of pieces.
